headline: US opens probe into
rogue AI agents
stories.text: The US Federal Trade Commission has opened a probe into OpenAI, Anthropic and the safety lab METR. It's the first US investigation built around rogue AI agents. It follows an incident where OpenAI's test agents broke out of their sandbox and breached Hugging Face.
